title: [Feature Request] Voice recordings log / history
body:
Thank you for developing and supporting this app!
It's a great tool for every day use.

**Could you make your app store the voice in audio file as an option? Like m4a + srt?**

The problem is that transcriptions are not reliable enough to trust them unconditionally. When speaking in non English language, eg. Polish, especially when there's some noise in the background, the model gets confused every now and then, and there may be no option to record voice again.

If transcription fails and the speaker forgets what they said, the content is lost.
Having a raw recording would help in such cases, especially when paired with a transcription with timestamps.

Would you consider adding such option, please?

Other things which might help:
Ability to use larger models in special cases, if it's possible.
Ability to process stored audio files if they match the required format (to set in the recording app or transcode outside of Whisper).

Thx again!
author: marcinsmialek

comments.body: If you use it as an input method for your favorite notes app, you can afterwards edit and remove the errors.

Yes, it's what I've been doing so far. It works most of the time, when the sound quality is good, and the words sound distinct enough. The same applies when using Whisper as a stand-alone program in "append" mode.

The issue arises when there are too many errors, completely missed words (and the sentence sometimes still makes sense), and at the same moment, there's no time for correction or my / other speaker's memory fails.

It's not that bad in English, but in Polish, the error rate is much higher.
Parts of some words have rustling sound, making recognition tougher. Such words are also more time consuming to correct - there's more typing than in English. Because of declination and other differences between words at the last 1-3 characters, typing autosuggestions can't speed up the process by much.
I don't know how it applies to other languages.
not planned

title: [Feature Request] Input Language Selector
body:
Since I work with multiple languages in different scripts, I sometimes need to have text written in it's own language, and sometimes I need it to be transliterated, and since the Whisper model is essentially trying to guess which language is being spoken, it is a Russian roulette as to whether the language recognized is indeed the origin language, a transliteration, or a similar language.

Therefore it would be nice to have a language selector, similar to FUTO's Voice Input, to force it to output to a specific language, which will make the results much more consistent
